assessments.reason: The paragraph makes caller allowance versus cancellation completion explicit and asks for observable pre-acquisition, pre-dispatch, uncertain-effect, and subsequent-useful-work checks. It leaves unexecuted checks proposed and preserves surrounding clock-domain, ownership, and reconciliation rules.

Existing behavior and new capability checks are separate obligations, including nontriggers and affected dependent boundaries. Historical inputs, rubrics, verifiers, and unsuccessful attempts are retained; intentional contract changes require explained versioned replacements. Independent results and coverage limits remain explicit. Concise reinforcement in repository and standalone agent contexts is appropriate.

The regression suite points to existing corpora; freeze filtering separates the two explicitly owned shared-corpus skills, and loadCase rejects a known case owned by the other skill. Dedicated existing corpora retain compatibility with omitted skill fields. Shared case IDs are already globally unique under the existing corpus contract. Default suite selection and record shape remain unchanged; runner content hashes necessarily change with runner bytes.
The existing pre-dispatch suite/control binding gate remains in place, and the executed synthetic test rejects a missing control suite before attempting to launch its nonexistent host.
